associations.rationale: This supplies the named truncated-polynomial module type but does not itself state simplicity, uniqueness, dimension, or the action of x.
The formal equality directly states that TruncPolySimple has k-dimension one for positive n.
The declaration directly states that the displayed truncated-polynomial module is simple.
It directly gives an equivalence from every simple module over the quotient to TruncPolySimple, expressing uniqueness up to equivalence.
The equality directly states that the quotient's root, representing x, acts by zero on TruncPolySimple.
